description: LyceanEM is a Python package for virtual prototyping of antenna arrays and radio channels. Its JOSS article describes electromagnetic simulation for communications and sensors, and the own README describes ray tracing around buildings, trains and aircraft with frequency-domain propagation. Spatial coverage is the user-supplied platform and environment geometry; temporal coverage is a selected operating condition, not a historical network record. The public repository reports GPL-3.0. A modeller could compare antenna placement or radio-link performance for transport and telecommunications infrastructure. A caveat is that simulations depend on material, scattering and propagation assumptions. An array result is not a measured coverage map or proof of service reliability in weather, interference or moving traffic. No directly related catalogue record was established. The article and own source were read without installing the solver or running an antenna case.
name: LyceanEM antenna and channel simulator
notes: G5 G5-0757. Software checked through metadata and documentation, without installation or execution. Geographic scope follows the documented application or software portability; it does not imply validation throughout that area.
